Title: From the work
Use when: You have a list of tasks.
Prompt: Turn this task list into a job description. Keep the tasks. Delete adjectives that do not change who would apply. Write the location and days on site only if I provided them.

Title: Must versus later
Prompt: Split the requirements into 'needed in the first month' and 'can be learned here'. Do not add requirements.
Check: Every line came from my list.

Title: Inclusive pass
Prompt: Point at lines that demand a degree, a tool, or a year-count that the tasks do not require. Do not rewrite the salary.
Check: You decide which lines to cut.

Title: Application ask
Prompt: Write the application instructions: three relevant projects, no photo, no identity number. Keep it under 120 words.
Check: The instructions do not ask for sensitive data.

Title: Rejection note
Prompt: Draft a short rejection that does not invent feedback. Thank them and state that we will not move forward.
Check: No fake praise of a specific skill.

Title: Scorecard
Prompt: Turn the must-have tasks into six interview questions with what a good answer includes. Do not ask about family, health, or age.
